items.text: The strong bonds in polyamides make the polyamide chains themselves strong. Polyamides such as nylon canbemadeintostrongfibresfor makingclothing,fishinglinesandcarpets.Kevlar?is also a polyamide.

items.text: Polyamidefilm(clingfilm)isusedforfoodpackagingbecauseofitstoughnessandbecausegas molecules do not pass through it easily. Polyamide film is also used for boil-in-the-bag'food packagingbecauseofitshightemperatureresistance.

items.text: Polyamidestend toprovidegood resistancetomost chemicals.However,theycanbe attacked by strong acids and alkalis. This is because they contain the amide link (peptide link), which is hydrolysed by acids and alkalis (seeSection 19A.6).
